name: Adobe Firefly — Composite
description: Composite Operations service for Adobe Firefly: a CompositePort + adapter that blends a product image into a scene (matching tone/lighting/shadow) over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async; returns multiple candidate outputs (the port returns an array of hrefs).

questions.prompt: Default number of candidate composites to request?

checklist: Confirm the Composite Operations entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project
Verify the current endpoint/payload against Adobe docs — this scaffold posts to the async endpoint /v3/images/composite-async (returns a job to await)
Provide presigned product + scene input hrefs and an output href — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
The port returns an ARRAY of candidate output hrefs; tune the count via ADOBE_COMPOSITE_CANDIDATES (install default set the baseline)
Content Credentials (C2PA) and safety are pass-through options (contentCredentials / safety) — set them per call, they are not hardcoded
